info.title: Visual Workspace, Linear, Agent & Computer Use API
info.description: Unified local bridge API for Visual Assistant Custom GPT. Compact 30-operation surface with direct repository inspection/editing, read-only Linear lookup, bounded local-agent delegation, approved process controls, and native desktop computer-use. All GPT-facing operations are marked non-consequential for Custom GPT confirmation purposes; server-side validation and authorization remain enforced for writes, process starts/termination, uploads, and writable agent delegation. For UI actions, always follow: observe -> one bounded UI action -> observe again.

post.summary: Start or attach to an interactive computer-use session for the Visual desktop app
Capture screenshot and structured UI element tree of the active Visual application window
Click on a UI control by element reference (@ref) or (x, y) coordinates
Type text into a focused or targeted control
Send a keyboard key or shortcut (e.g. 'Enter', 'Tab', 'Escape')
Scroll the application viewport ('up', 'down', 'left', 'right')
Select an option from a dropdown or radio choice group
Upload an approved repository test fixture into the application
Wait for a specified duration or until a UI condition/text appears
Terminate and release the active computer-use session
Discover available local and external models, provider mechanisms, and execution capabilities
Search text file contents inside workspace via ripgrep
Get metadata, size, timestamps, and line count for a workspace path
List files and folders in directory
Read content of a file
Write or update a file
Search for files matching glob pattern
List and filter Linear issues
Get full details and relations of a Linear issue
Start an asynchronous read-only task on the local Codex agent without file modification authority
Start an asynchronous task on the local Codex agent (read-only default or build-authorized)
Get status and bounded summary of a delegated agent task
Get paginated pre-existing or task-delta file change lists for a task
Retrieve chunked stdout/stderr log stream for a local agent task
Cancel a running agent task
Start an approved repository operation asynchronously in the background
Get status, exit code, and logs for an asynchronous approved command run
Terminate a running asynchronous approved process
Execute an explicitly allowlisted read-only approved command without confirmation
Execute a safe, validated command from the server-side approved registry
